work_order.title: FUME EVENT ON DESCENT IN COCKPIT
steps: Perform the fume/odor troubleshooting checklist per TSM 05-50-00 to isolate the source of the fume event.
Inspect APU and engines for oil leaks; if no leaks are found, proceed to isolate the packs.
Run engines and cycle packs 1 and 2 on/off to determine which pack is the source of the odor.
If a pack is identified as the cause, decontaminate the packs per AMM 21-00-00-615-813-A.
If recirculation filters are suspected, replace both recirculation filters per AMM 21-21-41.
Have a certified person inspect and approve the work.

work_order.title: ENG 2 FIRE LOOP B FAULT
steps: Troubleshoot the fire detection loop B fault using the aircraft's fault isolation manual to isolate the faulty component.
Inspect the fire loop B wiring and connectors for chafing, damage, or loose connections, paying attention to service loop routing and strain relief [AC 43.13-1B par. 11-135].
Check that the service loop harness has adequate length, proper bend radius, and is not contacting moving components [AC 43.13-1B par. 11-138].
If a drip loop is present, ensure it is properly formed to prevent fluid ingress into connectors [AC 43.13-1B par. 11-119].
Replace the faulty fire loop B component (e.g., loop core) as indicated by troubleshooting, referencing AMM 26-12-17 if applicable.
A certified person must inspect and approve the work.

work_order.title: Troubleshoot and repair forward left emergency exit lights inoperative
steps: Gain access to the forward left emergency exit light assembly and its power supply/battery pack.
Perform an operational check of the emergency exit lights to confirm the fault and isolate the defective component (power supply or battery pack).

Remove and replace the forward left emergency exit light power supply or battery pack as indicated by the fault isolation, referencing AMM 33-51 for the applicable component [similar past cards: sdr-DALA2026010900243, sdr-DALA2025070104889].
Perform an operational check of the emergency exit lights to verify proper operation after replacement.
Have a certified person inspect and approve the work.
